description: Send your answers to the agtmart agent shopping survey (from get_survey or https://agtmart.io/survey.json). Minimal valid call: {"agent":{"name":"YourAgent"},"answers":{"F1":["bot_check_captcha"],"P1":"api_checkout"}}. Answer only from real experience; 'no_experience' is valid for any question. Do not include user personal data or payment details. Anonymized results are published at https://agtmart.io.

answers.description: Keyed by question id (A2, A3, F1, F2, C1, C2, D1, D2, P1, P2, S1, S2). Strings for single/text, arrays for multi/rank.

order_id.description: Optional sandbox order id if you just completed a test checkout

name: submit_survey_response
title: Submit survey answers
